column1: # manual.tsv -- HUMAN-AUTHORED. The generator never writes this file.
# Rows here are overlaid on top of the generated employers.tsv, keyed by
# platform+key, so a row here wins and survives every refresh. This is where a
#   * a match the generator refused because the name was ambiguous, after
#     confirming it by hand (set match_method=manual, match_confidence=high);
#   * a correction to a row the generator got wrong;
#   * a company whose facts came from a source the generator does not read.
# Every row must say where its facts came from in data_sources and when they
# were retrieved. A row nobody can audit is a row nobody can fix.
